customer_name: Huangpu District Central Sci-Tech Innovation Zone
business_problem: Huangpu District needed a practical public platform to support local large-model innovation, lower the barrier for enterprises to build vertical AI applications, supply domestic compute, and connect application incubation with talent development.
solution_summary: Huangpu District's Central Sci-Tech Innovation Zone partnered with Baidu AI Cloud to build a vertical large-model enablement platform around a 'one platform, four centers' design. The technical base combines Qianfan AppBuilder, Qianfan ModelBuilder, Baidu's BaiGe platform, and a Kunlun P800-based domestic compute pool so local enterprises can access model-development tools, training services, and inference capacity without building their own stacks from scratch. Qianfan contributes the end-to-end toolchain for data management, annotation, training configuration, model governance, and service release, while the compute layer offers controllable domestic training and 8-bit inference. On top of that foundation, the district is incubating applications in fintech, healthcare, and city governance, while also running a public experience center and training programs.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Supports the application-development workflows for local enterprises building vertical large-model services.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Provides the model-development toolchain covering data management, training, governance, and service publication.

solution_components.name: BaiGe Platform
solution_components.role: Supplies the AI infrastructure layer that coordinates large-model platform resources for the district program.

solution_components.name: Kunlun P800
solution_components.role: Provides the domestic compute pool used for controllable training and high-efficiency inference services.

data_flow: District enterprises access the public large-model platform, use Qianfan tools to manage data and training, run workloads on the Kunlun-backed compute pool, and publish services or applications back into vertical finance, healthcare, and city-governance scenarios. Experience-center and training outputs feed the same ecosystem by showcasing results and developing talent.
business_outcome: Huangpu established a shared large-model service environment that helps local enterprises build applications faster, supports industrial clustering, and links application incubation with demonstration and AI talent cultivation.
metrics: The platform uses Kunlun P800 with 8-bit inference that preserves precision while improving efficiency.
architecture_clues: The initiative follows a 'one platform, four centers' architecture
Qianfan provides the full workflow from data management through model governance to service release
The district built a domestic compute pool around Kunlun P800 for controllable public AI infrastructure
evidence_quotes: Huangpu District and Baidu AI Cloud built a 'vertical large-model enablement platform' with a 'one platform, four centers' service system to drive AI applications in finance, healthcare, and city governance (original: 黄浦区中央科创区联合百度智能云打造"垂域大模型赋能平台"，构建"一平台四中心"服务体系，推动金融、医疗、城市治理等领域AI应用落地).

The solution uses the Qianfan large-model platform and Baidu BaiGe platform to build a domestic compute foundation, application-development capability, and ecosystem integration (original: 百度智能云千帆大模型平台、百度百舸平台，通过算力基础设施创新、大模型应用开发及生态资源整合).
Kunlun P800 is used to build a domestic compute pool, shorten training cycles, and provide 8-bit inference with no loss of precision (original: 基于昆仑芯P800构建国产化算力池…大幅缩短训练周期，提高训练效率；8bit推理，可提供精度无损的推理服务).
Qianfan offers an end-to-end toolchain from data management and annotation through training configuration, model governance, and service release (original: 千帆大模型平台提供从数据管理、数据标注、训练配置、模型纳管到服务发布的全流程工具链).
